notes: TRANSCRIPTION METHOD (ADR-013's accepted cost): two independent readings that had to agree, both taken from the FROZEN vendor copy. The PDF uses a CID font whose glyph codes are NOT character codes; the mapping was NOT guessed - the PDF's own /ToUnicode CMap (52 entries) was parsed and used, and it happens to reduce to a single constant shift of +0x1D. WHY Mfg WAS REMOVED: ngspice evaluates the unknown parameter's value as an expression and dies - 'Undefined parameter [linear_systems]', 'ERROR: fatal error in ngspice, exit(1)'. Verified by running it. That failure is loud, not silent. FOUR PARAMETERS ARE ACCEPTED AND THEN IGNORED by ngspice, with a warning on every run: isr, alpha, vk, mj (PSpice/LTspice refinements of the gate junction and the saturation current). They are kept in the model line deliberately - minimal diff from the vendor text, and a simulator that supports them gets the vendor's own values. Those four warnings are EXPECTED output. The parameters NC-004 actually needs - Kf, Af, Nlev, Gdsnoi - are accepted by ngspice, which is the point of this file.
